entities.summary: The Cathedral Basilica of Our Lady of Assumption, also called in Portuguese Catedral da Sé de Mariana, is a Catholic cathedral-basilica, the seat of the Archdiocese of Mariana. It is located in the state of Minas Gerais, in the city of Mariana, Brazil. It is dedicated to Our Lady of the Assumption.
